nesys_certerror.description: NESYS service repeatedly fails with CertError during boot (status[4] option[0])
nesys_certerror.root_cause: NESYS service (NesysService.exe) crashes immediately with exit code -1; game cannot authenticate

openkey_json_missing.root_cause: File never created because NESYS was never online to generate it
openkey_json_missing.effect: SystemDataCheck fails → DispError → game enters error state

bgameconnect_gating.description: TCP address resolved but connection never established after error state
bgameconnect_gating.root_cause: SystemDataCheck error state may abort TCP connection callback; game transitions to PromotionMovie instead of completing TCP handshake
bgameconnect_gating.effect: No TCP connection observed on server console

tcp_resolution_slow.description: TCP address resolution took ~750ms (02:36.41:055 → 02:36.41:804) for localhost
tcp_resolution_slow.effect: Resolution completed but error state was already triggered

operator_forced_close.description: Game closed by operator at 02:37:33, NOT spontaneous crash
operator_forced_close.root_cause: Operator closed the window (Closing by request)
operator_forced_close.effect: Render thread crash at 02:38:27 is aftermath of forced close, not root cause

classification.description: The game-level bGameConnect flag gates TCP connection establishment. NESYS offline → OpenKey missing → SystemDataCheck error → bGameConnect never set → TCP connection aborted. The server was ready 3+ minutes before HTTP request.
secondary_factors: NESYS CertError blocks NESYS authentication (root cause of offline state)
SystemDataCheck error state prevents TCP completion
classification.conclusive_evidence: TCP address was resolved (line 108161-108163) but no TCP connection was established after the resolution. The only event between resolution and game close was the SystemDataCheck error (DispError at line 108157-108159).
